messages:
sam.ops: Heads up — vendor (VentroLog) just flagged 12 H100 units held at FRA customs, possible HS code dispute. AWB 123-4567890. ETA for release unknown.
maria.supply: Ugh. Those were meant for eu-west-1 rack-42 deployment tomorrow. How long vendor estimates?
vendor-contact: We're escalating with customs, typical delay 24-72h. We can split the release: 8 units cleared faster if we pay broker fee ~€1,200, else all delayed. 
kenna-ops: If >24h we'll miss the rack SLA. Is there an option to re-route cleared units direct to our DC using alternate AWB?
vendor-contact: Yes, can reissue AWB for express courier for cleared units. Need sign-off on customs paperwork (I will DM doc link).
sam.ops: Ok prioritize 8 units via express. Approve broker fee if it avoids deploy rollback. @maria.supply approve?
maria.supply: Approved, charge to #procurement-expedite. Please confirm insurance covers re-route.
vendor-contact: Forwarder confirms insurance ok for re-routed pieces, standard carrier terms. 
liam.sre: Can we hot-swap partial capacity? If 8 come, we'll spin up 1/2 of the rack now, keep KV-cache warm plans.
kenna-ops: Yep — we'll stage 8 into priority pool and mark 4 as backfill. Update deploy plan.
forwarder-bot: AWB update: 123-4567890 -> split into 123-4567890A (8 units) and 123-4567890B (4 units). Tracker: https://track.courier/123-4567890A
sam.ops: Good. Also vendor asked about temporary serial reassignment to speed manifest — do NOT accept. We need traceability for RMAs.
maria.supply: Agreed. No serial swaps. If customs wants to hold originals, we'll wait or ask vendor to re-export.
vendor-contact: Understood. We'll proceed with express for the 8 without changing serials. Sending customs forms now.
sam.ops: Thanks. Once AWB A clears, @liam.sre reach out to infra-run to prep nodes. Keep thread for invoices and broker receipts :receipt:.
kenna-ops: noting action items:
```
- vendor: send customs docs + invoice for broker fee
- finance: approve payment to forwarder
- ops: ready staging for 8 H100s
- sres: verify warmup scripts
```
sam.ops: I'll file RMA-protocol note in docs after closure. Ping if anything changes.
